title: Sumac-style turkey salad
summary: Sumac-style turkey salad is a middle eastern dinner built around turkey breast steaks and cucumber, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Sumac-style turkey salad chopped before the pan goes on. Pat turkey breast steaks dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook turkey breast steaks until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook cucumber and little gem lettuce until hot and lightly browned. Return turkey breast steaks and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Sumac-style turkey salad, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
steps.tip: Taste Sumac-style turkey salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
